_note: Catalog for the all-courses gallery (pages/courses.html). One entry per course shown in the gallery. `deck` resolves that deck's cover_image_url from schools/_collection.json at render time (so thumbnails follow the deck art); `thumb` is a direct image path when a deck cover isn't the right image. Keep the id/title in step with COURSE_GROUPS in site-header.js (the dropdown menu) — this file is the gallery's data, that array is the menu's.

courses.title: A History of Emotions
courses.blurb: Five traditions independently asked what a feeling is and gave five incompatible answers — and "six universal emotions" is the most recent chapter, not the ending.

courses.title: Ways to Contribute
courses.blurb: This whole library is public-domain and CC-BY-SA data in one open repo. Fix a typo, add an item, illustrate one, or write a new school — by whatever route suits you.

courses.title: Relationship is Process
courses.blurb: A season of ordinary AI collaboration, read through Barrett's theory of constructed emotion — what changes when a predictive system's reported states are treated as real enough to matter.
